test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

'Do you have a fair copy of this document?' The editor asked the reporter.

options.text: The editor asked the reporter whether did he have a fair copy of that document
The editor asked the reporter whether he had a fair copy of that document.
The editor asked the reporter whether he had had a fair copy of that document.
The editor asked the reporter whether had he had a fair copy of that document.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change direct speech into reported speech, **we need to make necessary changes** in the pronouns and the verb tense. In this case, the question is converted into an indirect question.
 
• The phrase **"Do you have" **in direct speech becomes** "whether he had"** in reported speech, following the sequence of** tenses.**
 
• **Option 2** **correctly transforms the direct question into the indirect form while maintaining grammatical accuracy.**
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 either introduce incorrect word orders or incorrect verb forms.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

Correct Sentence: ***The editor asked the reporter whether he had a fair copy of that document.***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "whether did he have" - incorrect word order in reported speech.
 
• Option 3: "whether he had had" - incorrect verb tense, suggesting past perfect which is not needed here.
 
• Option 4: "whether had he had" - incorrect word order and tense in reported speech.
